messages:
rachel: quick heads-up — we're seeing intermittent tokenization failures for hosted-api in eu-west-1 since ~14:03 UTC. A small % of requests return a 422 error. opening thread. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1864809999
devon: oncall here. put a soft reject on malformed inputs and enabled a guarded fallback tokenizer (v2) for known customers. error rate dropped from ~3.4% to ~0.5%.
mark: i'm seeing a mismatched unicode normalization edge-case in the new tokenizer C library after the recent upgrade. writing a patch to normalize NFKC before tokenization. will push a hotfix.
infra: rolled back tokenizer-lib to 2026.03.18 on the eu-west-1 pool for production lanes; rollout started batch 1/3. sha=88bb7a.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback in progress for tokenizer-lib on eu-west-1, batch 1/3. CI: https://ci.redwood/build/8012
support: alerted 7 impacted customers; message sent: "We're aware of tokenization errors causing 422 responses in eu-west-1. We've applied temporary fallbacks and are rolling a fix. We'll update when resolved."
devon: after batch 2 rollback, 422s down to <0.2%. proceeding with batch 3. monitoring message queues and ingest backpressure.
mark: hotfix v3 normalizes utf forms and adds a defensive path for mixed byte sequences. PR ready, but since rollback fixed most traffic, i'll coordinate a canary with devon before full roll.
infra: batch 3 complete; eu-west-1 pools are stable. keeping throttles on malformed inputs for 1 hour to avoid regressions.
ops-bot: monitor: error-rate eu-west-1 tokenization alert cleared (id=tok-9987).
rachel: severity=SEV4. schedule a short postmortem to cover upgrade gating and character encoding tests. final incident doc: https://go.redwood/incident/1864809999/summary
